pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce the PythonLibAction repository, explaining its purpose as an educational platform for AI/ML development in Python, and provide a high-level map of its components

pages.title: Environment Setup
pages.purpose: Comprehensive guide to setting up the development environment, including OS requirements, Python installation, GPU support, and package management

pages.title: Operating System and Python Installation
pages.purpose: Detail the WSL2 Ubuntu setup and Python 3.10.11 installation process, including manual compilation for low-version systems

pages.title: GPU Support (CUDA and cuDNN)
pages.purpose: Explain CUDA 11.8 and cuDNN 8.9.7 installation, environment variable configuration, and verification procedures

pages.title: Package Management
pages.purpose: Cover modern Python package management using uv and virtualenv, including pyproject.toml configuration and offline installation strategies

pages.title: Data Processing Pipeline
pages.purpose: Overview of the data processing ecosystem, from extraction to transformation to storage

pages.title: Data Extraction and Parsing
pages.purpose: Demonstrate parsing various data formats (JSON, XML, HTML, CSV) using lxml, BeautifulSoup4, and pandas

pages.title: Data Analysis with Pandas
pages.purpose: Comprehensive guide to pandas DataFrame and Series operations, including cleaning, transformation, and aggregation

pages.title: Database Systems
pages.purpose: Overview of the three database paradigms supported: relational (MySQL), document (MongoDB), and vector (FAISS)

pages.title: MySQL with SQLAlchemy ORM
pages.purpose: Detailed guide to SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM patterns, including Engine setup, declarative models, Session management, and CRUD operations with the Person entity example

pages.title: MongoDB with PyMongo
pages.purpose: Explain MongoDB document database operations using the pymongo driver

pages.title: FAISS Vector Search
pages.purpose: Cover FAISS library for efficient similarity search and vector indexing, including IndexFlatL2, IndexIVFFlat, and GPU acceleration

pages.title: Machine Learning Frameworks
pages.purpose: Overview of the deep learning frameworks supported (PyTorch and TensorFlow) and their role in the ecosystem

pages.title: PyTorch Basics
pages.purpose: Introduction to PyTorch tensor operations, including creation methods (torch.tensor vs torch.Tensor), dtypes, and basic operations

pages.title: TensorFlow Setup
pages.purpose: Explain TensorFlow 2.12.1 installation and verification with GPU support

pages.title: HuggingFace Transformers Ecosystem
pages.purpose: Comprehensive overview of the Transformers library ecosystem, including models, tokenizers, datasets, training infrastructure, and evaluation

pages.title: Getting Started with Transformers
pages.purpose: Introduction to the Transformers library, covering Auto* classes, model loading, and basic inference patterns

pages.title: Tokenization
pages.purpose: Detailed guide to AutoTokenizer usage, including tokenization methods, padding, truncation, special tokens, attention masks, and Fast vs Slow tokenizers

pages.title: Models and Pipelines
pages.purpose: Explain the Pipeline API for high-level inference, covering supported tasks (NLP, CV, Audio), configuration options, and comparison with manual model usage

pages.title: Working with Datasets
pages.purpose: Comprehensive guide to the HuggingFace datasets library, including loading from Hub/CSV/JSON, dataset operations, tokenization mapping, and DataLoader preparation

pages.title: Model Training and Evaluation
pages.purpose: Explain the Trainer API, TrainingArguments configuration, custom metrics with the evaluate library, and complete training workflows

pages.title: Advanced Training Techniques
pages.purpose: Cover PEFT (Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning), LoRA, accelerate for distributed training, optimum for hardware optimization, and mixed precision training

pages.title: LLM Deployment
pages.purpose: Overview of local LLM deployment using Ollama and OpenWebUI for production-ready model serving

pages.title: Ollama Setup and Configuration
pages.purpose: Detailed guide to Ollama installation, Modelfile syntax (FROM, TEMPLATE, PARAMETER, STOP), model creation, and runtime execution

pages.title: OpenWebUI Interface
pages.purpose: Explain OpenWebUI 0.6.36 installation, SQLite3 upgrade requirements, ChromaDB patching for pysqlite3, and web interface usage

pages.title: Complete Examples and Tutorials
pages.purpose: Collection of end-to-end examples demonstrating complete workflows from data loading to model deployment

pages.title: Sentiment Analysis Tutorial
pages.purpose: Complete walkthrough of building a Chinese sentiment classifier using the ChnSentiCorp dataset, including custom Dataset class, training loop, and inference

pages.title: Custom Dataset Loading
pages.purpose: Demonstrate creating custom dataset loaders using the datasets library, with CMRC2018 question-answering dataset as an example
